claim: Architecture correction on 2026-05-15: the 'proposal to gatekeeper' framing was replaced by 'LLM operator + deterministic helper accelerators'. Helpers accelerate mechanics and enforce invariants; they do not replace LLM reasoning.
summary: Earlier design described: LLM proposes -> deterministic judge decides -> DB stores. This was too single-tiered and implied helpers were final philosophical judges. Corrected to: LLM thinks -> uses memory tools -> helpers accelerate/constrain mechanics -> storage/indexes return exact evidence -> LLM reasons again. Documented in docs/braincase-memory-tool-api.md, committed in cf31592.
